name: Tian yuan: Chinese celestial-element algebra
summary: A positional notation for polynomials in an unknown, extended to four unknowns, let equations be set up and manipulated.

name: Nasir al-Din al-Tusi: trigonometry as independent discipline
summary: Al-Tusi's Quadrilateral treated plane and spherical trigonometry separately from astronomy.

name: Oresme: graphing motion
summary: Uniform acceleration was studied and shown by area under a velocity diagram.

name: Kerala series
summary: Madhava and followers derived series for sine, cosine and arctangent.

name: Projective geometry from Renaissance perspective
summary: Painters' perspective became a geometric theory in Alberti and Piero, del Monte proved vanishing points, and Desargues treated conics projectively with points at infinity.

name: Regiomontanus: trigonometry separated from astronomy in Europe
summary: De triangulis omnimodis presented trigonometry as a branch in its own right.

name: Complex numbers born from the cubic: Cardano and Bombelli
summary: The Cardano-Tartaglia cubic formula gave square roots of negative numbers in the irreducible case, which Bombelli analysed.

name: Cardano: first treatise on chance
summary: Dice outcomes were analysed by counting favourable cases; the book appeared posthumously.

name: Viete symbolic algebra
summary: Letters were used for both unknown and known quantities in a systematic method for equations.

name: Viete: trigonometry applied to algebra
summary: A degree-45 equation posed by van Roomen was solved by recognising a trigonometric identity.
